run_lasso_path: run lasso_path to compute the regularization path of coefficients for the Lasso model
run_positive_lasso_path: run lasso_path with positive=True to compute the constrained Lasso regularization path
run_lars_path: run lars_path with method=lasso to compute the LARS regularization path for Lasso
run_positive_lars_path: run lars_path with method=lasso and positive=True to compute the constrained LARS path
run_enet_path: run enet_path to compute the Elastic Net regularization path with l1_ratio=0.8
